meta.name: feature-investment-advisor
meta.description: Evaluate feature investments using revenue impact, cost structure, ROI, and strategy. Use when deciding whether a feature deserves investment.

copy.tagline: 评估功能投资回报，辅助决策是否投入资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要判断某个功能是否值得投入开发资源
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate feature investments to decide resource allocation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide whether a feature deserves development investment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你评估一个功能是否值得投资。它会问你关于收入影响、成本、ROI 和战略价值的问题，最后给出“建”、“不建”或“再验证”的建议，并附上计算依据。
howto.when: 当你需要决定是否要开发某个功能，尤其是涉及财务影响时触发。例如，你在评估一个需要超过1个工程师月的工作量的功能。

say.text: 我们该不该做SSO功能？企业客户因为缺少这个在流失。
say.note: Claude 会引导你评估SSO的财务影响。

say.text: 评估一下AI助手功能是否值得投资。
say.note: Claude 会询问收入连接、成本等细节。

say.text: 帮我看看这个路线图请求的ROI够不够。
say.note: Claude 会进行ROI计算并给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through evaluating whether a feature is worth investing in. It asks about revenue impact, cost, ROI, and strategic value, then gives a build/don't build/validate recommendation with supporting math.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to decide whether to build a feature, especially with financial implications. For example, when evaluating a feature requiring more than 1 engineer-month of work.

say_en.text: Should we build SSO? Enterprise deals are stalling without it.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through evaluating SSO's financial impact.

say_en.text: Evaluate whether an AI assistant feature is worth the investment.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about revenue connection, costs, etc.

say_en.text: Help me decide if this roadmap request has enough ROI to build.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate ROI and give a recommendation.
